title: Use exact primal-dual gaps to qualify a numerical projection proposal
statement: For compressed qubit POVM centers, the source uses the rational Lorentz-cone PSD test, exact primal repair and a rigorous lower dual value. It accepts only exact PSD effects summing to I with finite-weight objective gap<=xi. Acquired reviews accept12288 recorded N4096 projections and733 meta updates plus separately bound huge-K/boundary certificates; they preserve negative learning scores and failed proposal cases.

evidence.quote: Write each Hermitian qubit matrix H=aI+xX+yY+zZ as a four-vector h. Then Tr(HG)=2 h.g and H>=0 iff a>=0 and a^2>=x^2+y^2+z^2. All these tests are rational.
